title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: repricing a disputed demurrage line
content:
## Scope

This rule of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category prices the recomputed demurrage line used to decide a rate-misapplied or free-time-misapplied dispute on a per-container record. It reads the cargo type of the container's booking.

## Rule

1. The rate class is taken from the product's equipment class map, save that a reefer-class container keeps reefer-class rates only under a booking whose cargo type is reefer, and is recomputed at dry-class rates under a booking of any other cargo type.
2. Each day takes the demurrage rate of its slab and class, raised by the product's dangerous-goods uplift percentage of itself when the booking's cargo type is dangerous goods.
3. The day rates are added and the sum is rounded to the cent; that figure is the recomputed amount.

## Repricing grid

| Mapped class | Booking cargo type | Class used | Uplift on each day rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| reefer | reefer | reefer | none |
| reefer | dangerous goods | dry | the product's uplift percentage |
| reefer | any other | dry | none |
| dry or special | dangerous goods | as mapped | the product's uplift percentage |
| dry or special | any other than dangerous goods | as mapped | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical demurrage rates of USD 50.00 in slab 2 and USD 70.00 in slab 3, and an illustrative uplift of 30 percent)

Four slab 2 days and one slab 3 day on a dangerous-goods booking: each slab 2 day is USD 65.00 and the slab 3 day USD 91.00, so the recomputed amount is USD 260.00 together with USD 91.00, that is USD 351.00. On a booking without dangerous goods the same days reprice at USD 270.00.
